79200.body:
Today’s newsletter is brought to you by **[Choose Rich Live](https://www.youtube.com/@chooserichnick/streams)**[!](https://www.youtube.com/@chooserichnick/streams)

Our very own Nick O’Neill is has launched a new stream covering crypto, finance, AI, tech, and the stories shaping the internet economy.

If you already follow Nick, you know what to expect: sharp takes, market chaos, founder brain, and the occasional banger you’ll see clipped on the timeline five minutes later.

Episodes will be streaming live on YouTube, so make sure you’re subscribed to catch the next one as it happens.

**[Subscribe to Choose Rich Live!](https://www.youtube.com/@chooserichnick/streams)**

* Trump has made nearly 29k securities trades across stocks and crypto, [more than all of Congress combined](https://x.com/coinbureau/status/2100001717475762640)

* Two Robinhood engineers are charged with [commodities and wire fraud](https://x.com/WuBlockchain/status/2099999861110399000) for trading Hyperliquid perps on unannounced crypto listings

* OpenAI weighs a funding round at a [$1.2T valuation](https://x.com/zerohedge/status/2100003527137325282) before an IPO

🧠 Crypto News Brief: Washington dealt crypto a heavy blow as the Senate stalled the CLARITY Act and Bitcoin slid below $75K. Markets now brace for a widely expected Fed rate hike. 🏛️ Senate Blocks the CLARITY Act in 49–50 Vote The Senate failed to invoke cloture on the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act, landing 11 votes short of the 60 required. Ethics provisions covering officials' crypto profits remained the sticking point, and lead sponsor Sen. Cynthia Lummis says the bill is effectively over for 2026 with the midterms approaching. Read full story 📉 Bitcoin Slips Below $75K as $771M Gets Liquidated BTC briefly broke under $75,000, its lowest level since late August, in a sharp sell-the-news reaction to the Senate vote. Roughly $771 million in leveraged positions were wiped out across the market within 24 hours, with longs accounting for about $568 million of the losses. More details 🏦 Coinbase, Circle and Galaxy Shares Tumble 8%+ Crypto equities sold off hard after the vote, with Coinbase dropping nearly 9% and stablecoin issuer Circle losing more than 9%. Galaxy also fell over 8% as investors priced out a near-term federal market-structure framework ahead of the Fed decision. Read more ⚖️ Industry Turns to SEC and CFTC to Fill the Gap Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong said the industry can no longer wait on Congress, while Ripple's Brad Garlinghouse urged regulators to step in. Former CFTC chair Chris Giancarlo said SEC Chair Paul Atkins and CFTC Chair Michael Selig are ready to build crypto frameworks under existing agency powers. See details 🦅 Fed Set to Announce Widely Expected Rate Hike The FOMC releases its decision at 2:00 PM ET today, with markets almost fully pricing a 25 bp hike that would lift the target range to 3.75%–4.00%. With oil back above $100 and inflation sticky, traders are watching whether Chair Kevin Warsh signals further tightening. Read full story 🪙 House Panel Takes Up Strategic Bitcoin Reserve Bill The House Financial Services Committee is marking up H.R. 8957, the American Reserve Modernization Act, today. The bill would write the Strategic Bitcoin Reserve into law, lock government-held BTC for at least 20 years, and task Treasury with studying budget-neutral ways to acquire more.
